name: Bargain
body:
You have an instinctual knack for dealing with money.

Prerequisite: Numistian, Wis 15

Benefit: You may add your Wisdom modifier as a competence bonus to Appraise and Diplomacy skill checks.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
